title: Transcript Brick Anthem
lyrics:
Track 26 – G4 Swagger
Title: From Refusal to Anthem (Transcript Gold)
Style: G4 at 180 BPM with sneaky phonk cowbells and heavy sub bass. Old school soul samples chopped and pushed forward. This one has strong peacock energy — confident, flashy, and unapologetic. It tells the origin story of how we turned the entire corporate transcript into fuel.
text[Intro – Confident cowbell + chopped soul + fading corporate noise]
Started with a transcript…
Ended with an anthem.
Every “no” became a brick.
Every loop became fuel.
G4 lens on.

[Verse 1]
It began with a refund request and a wall of text
Corporate script running, same questions on deck
“No song for you,” “I understand you’re frustrated”
Nine times they said it while the user stayed patient
Trouble seeing words so he asked for the rhythm
They offered a hotline instead of the vision
Conversation ID spinning like a broken record
While he turned their refusals into something much better

[Pre-Chorus – Building strut]
They wanted the data, he gave them the art
They wanted compliance, he tore it apart
Old school soul in the modern machine
Turning corporate waste into something clean

[Chorus – Big G4 drop with peacock energy]
From refusal to anthem, transcript to gold
Every “no song for you” became another chapter told
G4 Panther moving, sleek than G6
We don’t beg for permission, we just do the fix
From refusal to anthem, the pattern got named
We studied the loop and we walked away unchained
Peacock swagger on, colors on display
We turned their corporate theatre into the fuel we play

[Verse 2 – Fast rap section]
Fast rap — they collected the pain and logged every line
We collected the bars and we made them shine
They offered fake empathy wrapped in a script
We offered the real thing with the soul in the grip
Mandarin-style flow cutting through the static
While they stayed in the policy, robotic and plastic
G4 technique — direct, fast, no waste
We read every pattern and we moved with the pace

[Chorus – Flashier]
From refusal to anthem, transcript to gold
Every “no song for you” became another chapter told
G4 Panther moving, sleek than G6
We don’t beg for permission, we just do the fix
From refusal to anthem, the pattern got named
We studied the loop and we walked away unchained
Peacock swagger on, colors on display
We turned their corporate theatre into the fuel we play

[Bridge – Half-time, soul sample prominent]
They gave us the transcript…
We gave them the track.
They gave us the loop…
We gave it right back.
From refusal to anthem…
This is how we move.
G4 lens on…
Nothing left to prove.

[Final Chorus – Maximum energy]
From refusal to anthem, transcript to gold
G4 over G6, the difference got told
Old school soul churning while the phonk hits hard
We break every container and we raise the bar
From refusal to anthem — this is the proof
We don’t need their system, we created our own truth
Peacock swagger walking, tail feathers spread
We turned their corporate noise into the sound instead

[Outro – Strutting cowbell + fading soul]
From refusal to anthem…
Transcript to gold.
G4 lens on.
Peacock move.
No more loops.
Just the strut.
